name: Skip To Checkout
summary: Free Shopify app from Effective Apps that puts a sticky add-to-cart bar on product pages and can send the shopper straight to checkout, skipping the cart. It also hides PayPal, Apple Pay or the add-to-cart and buy-now buttons when you want a single path to payment. Free is the only plan and there is no usage meter. Built for Shopify, on the App Store since November 2019.
best_for: Shopify merchants who want a free sticky buy button, or who need to hide add-to-cart and express-payment buttons on products they list online but sell in person
skip_if: your cart page carries shipping thresholds, discount codes or upsells you depend on, you manage the store on add-to-cart rate and cannot afford to lose that signal, or you are unwilling to grant read and write access to customers, products and analytics for a display widget
honest_knock: The cart skip blinds the measurement you would use to judge it. The vendor's own help article confirms that bypassing Add To Cart and Start Checkout makes your add-to-cart rate read lower, and recommends watching overall sales trends instead, so the feature is sold on conversion while switching off the funnel that would show it. Skipping the cart also bypasses the page where shipping thresholds, discount codes and cart upsells normally work. For a free widget the permissions are broad: view and edit customers, products, store analytics, Shopify Functions and the online store, plus customer device and activity data. And because there is no paid tier there is no support contract behind it; what you get is the vendor's goodwill, which a six-year run and a 4.6 average suggest is real, but is not something you can buy more of. The app also carries at least three different names across the listing, the help centre index and its own setup article, which makes it harder to know what you are running.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-19 on apps.shopify.com/cart-auto-update, where the listing now names the app PF: Skip To Checkout/Skip Cart; first read 2026-09-18) Free, and free is the only plan. The listing carries no pricing table at all: no paid tier, no usage meter and no surcharge tied to your Shopify plan. The app has been on the App Store since 29 November 2019 and carries Shopify's Built for Shopify badge, which is the store's own bar for performance, design and integration. One of the 34 reviews on the listing on 18 September (36 on 19 October) alleges being billed twice, which is worth knowing about an app the listing prices at nothing; we cannot verify that claim from the outside, and the listing shows no charge to make.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Skip To Checkout, called PF AI: Skip to Checkout in the admin, on a Shopify development store: the install, Skip To Checkout switched on, the app embed switched on, the sticky bar with the button action Direct Buy, the preview in which a click on Shop now went straight to the checkout with one product, and the uninstall dialog, after which the app was uninstalled. Two theme changes were saved. Nothing was paid and no plan page exists on the Free Plan. Install: the install button of the App Store listing (apps.shopify.com/cart-auto-update) opened a new tab outside our tab group, so the install was done again through the form in our own tab. The Install app dialog showed Skip to Checkout by Effective Apps and the access View customer data (Device and activity data), View staff and contributor data (Store owner) and View and edit store data (Customers, products, store analytics, Shopify Functions, Online Store). Install was approved at about 15:24. The app is called PF AI: Skip to Checkout in the admin, with the label Free Plan; the App Store title is now STKY: Sticky Add To Cart Bar, free, 4.8 stars from 38 reviews. The session began at about 15:21. Core action, Skip To Checkout so that the buy button goes straight to the checkout: the dashboard Getting Started lists Enable Skip To Checkout, Enable Sticky Add To Cart Bar App Embed, Enable an Additional Tool and Verify your setup, and an advertisement for another app of the maker is at the top. The page Skip To Checkout says ACTION REQUIRED: Activate the App Embed (The App Embed must be toggled on from the theme settings for Skip To Checkout to work.). Turn on gave Unsaved changes, Save gave Settings saved. The choice Checkout Redirection Type offers Start a checkout just the product that was added to the cart or Start a checkout with the entire cart contents, and the second was selected. In the theme editor, under App embeds, PF Add To Cart/Buy Now was switched on and saved (Changes saved.), which is a theme change that was needed. In the theme preview (without a password), on the product page The Inventory Not Tracked Snowboard, the Add to cart button of the theme only opened the cart drawer (Your cart) and did not go to the checkout, also not after a reload, so switching Skip To Checkout on was not enough in this theme. The sticky bar already showed in the editor (Shop now) but with Button click action: Standard Add to Cart. We changed it to Skip to Checkout (Direct Buy) with Checkout mode: Current product only and saved it, a second theme change. Result in the preview: a click on Shop now in the sticky bar (The Inventory Not Tracked Snowboard, $949.95) went straight to Checkout of the shop with only that product (1 piece, $949.95, Total USD $949.95), with no cart page and no cart upsell. The preview bar of Shopify at the bottom hid the sticky bar until Hide bar. Time, approximate tester observations: about 3 minutes from the install at about 15:24 to the checkout at about 15:27, in more than 10 steps (install, switch Skip on, switch the embed on and save, open the preview, change the button action and save, reload the preview, hide the bar, Shop now). Plans and checkout: only Free Plan was seen; there was no plan page and no Shopify approval screen, nothing was paid and no card was asked, which agrees with the listing (Free). Cancelling: no subscription ran. Removing the app goes through Settings, Apps, the menu of the app and Uninstall; the dialog Uninstall Skip to Checkout? says you will no longer be able to use the app, that any data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted, and that a request goes to the app developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information. A reason is required (the Uninstall button stays grey until one is chosen) and Testing multiple apps was chosen. The app was uninstalled at about 15:28 and left the installed list. Not tested: hiding Add to cart or Buy it now for shops that sell in person, the sticky bar on a phone and the scrolling on long product pages (Show on Mobile), the effect on the add to cart rate, Verify Setup (it asks the vendor experts) and the vendor contact. No call, demo or separate account was asked. Clean up: two theme changes (the app embed on and the button action Direct Buy) stay saved in the theme test-data, but the embed belongs to the app and goes away with the uninstall; the cart of the preview already held products from earlier tests and one Snowboard was added, so it held 2 pieces after the test; the app was uninstalled; one tab that the install button opened outside our tab group could not be closed with our tools. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: Switching Skip To Checkout on was not enough in this theme: the theme Add to cart button still opened the cart drawer, and only the button action of the sticky bar, set to Skip to Checkout (Direct Buy), led to the checkout; the app embed has to be switched on in the theme editor; the install button opened a tab outside our tab group; the app has a different name in the admin and in the App Store; and the dashboard shows an advertisement for another app of the maker.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Skip To Checkout, called PF AI: Skip to Checkout in the admin, on a Shopify development store: the install, Skip To Checkout switched on, the app embed switched on, the sticky bar with the button action Direct Buy, the preview in which a click on Shop now went straight to the checkout with one product, and the uninstall dialog, after which the app was uninstalled. Two theme changes were saved. Nothing was paid and no plan page exists on the Free Plan. Install: the install button of the App Store listing (apps.shopify.com/cart-auto-update) opened a new tab outside our tab group, so the install was done again through the form in our own tab. The Install app dialog showed Skip to Checkout by Effective Apps and the access View customer data (Device and activity data), View staff and contributor data (Store owner) and View and edit store data (Customers, products, store analytics, Shopify Functions, Online Store). Install was approved at about 15:24. The app is called PF AI: Skip to Checkout in the admin, with the label Free Plan; the App Store title is now STKY: Sticky Add To Cart Bar, free, 4.8 stars from 38 reviews. The session began at about 15:21. Core action, Skip To Checkout so that the buy button goes straight to the checkout: the dashboard Getting Started lists Enable Skip To Checkout, Enable Sticky Add To Cart Bar App Embed, Enable an Additional Tool and Verify your setup, and an advertisement for another app of the maker is at the top. The page Skip To Checkout says ACTION REQUIRED: Activate the App Embed (The App Embed must be toggled on from the theme settings for Skip To Checkout to work.). Turn on gave Unsaved changes, Save gave Settings saved. The choice Checkout Redirection Type offers Start a checkout just the product that was added to the cart or Start a checkout with the entire cart contents, and the second was selected. In the theme editor, under App embeds, PF Add To Cart/Buy Now was switched on and saved (Changes saved.), which is a theme change that was needed. In the theme preview (without a password), on the product page The Inventory Not Tracked Snowboard, the Add to cart button of the theme only opened the cart drawer (Your cart) and did not go to the checkout, also not after a reload, so switching Skip To Checkout on was not enough in this theme. The sticky bar already showed in the editor (Shop now) but with Button click action: Standard Add to Cart. We changed it to Skip to Checkout (Direct Buy) with Checkout mode: Current product only and saved it, a second theme change. Result in the preview: a click on Shop now in the sticky bar (The Inventory Not Tracked Snowboard, $949.95) went straight to Checkout of the shop with only that product (1 piece, $949.95, Total USD $949.95), with no cart page and no cart upsell. The preview bar of Shopify at the bottom hid the sticky bar until Hide bar. Time, approximate tester observations: about 3 minutes from the install at about 15:24 to the checkout at about 15:27, in more than 10 steps (install, switch Skip on, switch the embed on and save, open the preview, change the button action and save, reload the preview, hide the bar, Shop now). Plans and checkout: only Free Plan was seen; there was no plan page and no Shopify approval screen, nothing was paid and no card was asked, which agrees with the listing (Free). Cancelling: no subscription ran. Removing the app goes through Settings, Apps, the menu of the app and Uninstall; the dialog Uninstall Skip to Checkout? says you will no longer be able to use the app, that any data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted, and that a request goes to the app developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information. A reason is required (the Uninstall button stays grey until one is chosen) and Testing multiple apps was chosen. The app was uninstalled at about 15:28 and left the installed list. Not tested: hiding Add to cart or Buy it now for shops that sell in person, the sticky bar on a phone and the scrolling on long product pages (Show on Mobile), the effect on the add to cart rate, Verify Setup (it asks the vendor experts) and the vendor contact. No call, demo or separate account was asked. Clean up: two theme changes (the app embed on and the button action Direct Buy) stay saved in the theme test-data, but the embed belongs to the app and goes away with the uninstall; the cart of the preview already held products from earlier tests and one Snowboard was added, so it held 2 pieces after the test; the app was uninstalled; one tab that the install button opened outside our tab group could not be closed with our tools. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: Switching Skip To Checkout on was not enough in this theme: the theme Add to cart button still opened the cart drawer, and only the button action of the sticky bar, set to Skip to Checkout (Direct Buy), led to the checkout; the app embed has to be switched on in the theme editor; the install button opened a tab outside our tab group; the app has a different name in the admin and in the App Store; and the dashboard shows an advertisement for another app of the maker.
